name: mealchain-decision-evidence-write-flow (propose -> verify -> approve x2 -> execute, termasuk pengadaan source NULL)

services.name: mutations stack
services.start: bash -lc "export MUT_BACKEND_PORT=18001; docker compose -p mcg-mut -f verify/docker-compose.mutations.yml up -d --wait backend"

http.name: A1. POST /decisions (regional_balance) -> 201 proposed
A2. GET /decisions/{id} -> proposed, asal Cianjur tujuan Jakarta
A3. POST /actions/propose -> pending_approval, wajib 2 approval
A4. POST /actions/verify tanpa provider -> UNAVAILABLE, recorded:false
A5. POST /actions/execute sebelum verdict -> 409 belum terverifikasi
A6. POST /actions/approve sebelum verdict -> 409 belum diverifikasi
A7. POST /actions/approve #1 SPPG head Jakarta -> 200
A8. POST /actions/execute dengan 1 dari 2 approval -> 409
A9. POST /actions/approve #2 nutritionist Jakarta -> 200 approved
A10. POST /actions/execute -> 200, PO mock MOCK terbit
A11. POST /actions/execute ulang -> 409 sudah dieksekusi
A12. GET /decisions/{id}/chain -> audit chain terbaca
B1. POST /decisions (supplier_procurement, TANPA source_location) -> 201
B2. GET /decisions/{id} -> supplier_procurement, source_location_id NULL, tujuan Jakarta
B3. POST /actions/propose pengadaan -> pending_approval, 2 role
B4. POST /actions/verify pengadaan tanpa provider -> UNAVAILABLE, recorded:false
B5. POST /actions/approve #1 head Jakarta -> 200
B6. POST /actions/approve #2 nutritionist Jakarta -> 200 approved
B7. GET approval-summary pengadaan sehat -> can_execute TRUE (paritas read model)
B8. GET approval-summary setelah batch pemasok dibuat FAIL -> can_execute FALSE + alasan safety
B9. GET approval-summary setelah batch dipulihkan -> can_execute TRUE lagi
B10. POST /actions/execute pengadaan (source NULL) -> 200 (dulu SELALU 409 'binding batch/supplier berubah')
B11. POST /actions/execute pengadaan ulang -> 409 sudah dieksekusi
C1. execute pengadaan dengan binding batch di LOKASI LAIN -> 409
C2. execute pengadaan dengan supplier binding BUKAN pemilik batch -> 409
C3. execute keputusan NON-pengadaan dengan source_location_id NULL -> 409 (fail-closed)

sql_steps.name: A: ikat allocation_binding ke batch Cianjur/telur (meniru fixture tes repo)
sql_steps.sql: INSERT INTO decision_evidence (decision_id, evidence_type, payload) SELECT '{var:did}', 'human_inspection', jsonb_build_object('allocation_binding', true, 'supplier_id', b.supplier_id::text, 'batch_ids', jsonb_build_array(b.id::text)) FROM batches b JOIN commodities c ON c.id = b.commodity_id JOIN locations l ON l.id = b.location_id WHERE c.name = 'telur' AND l.name = 'Cianjur' AND b.origin = 'seed' ORDER BY b.id LIMIT 1

sql_steps.name: A: catat verdict verifier (verified_by + consistent) — meniru fixture resmi, produksi butuh provider
sql_steps.after: A6. POST /actions/approve sebelum verdict -> 409 belum diverifikasi
sql_steps.sql: UPDATE decisions SET verified_by = 'gate-verifier-fixture', verifier_note = 'consistent' WHERE id = '{var:did}'

sql_steps.name: B: supplier_id keputusan pengadaan = pemilik batch pemasok di SPPG tujuan (meniru orchestrator produksi)
sql_steps.sql: UPDATE decisions d SET supplier_id = (SELECT b.supplier_id FROM batches b JOIN suppliers s ON s.id = b.supplier_id JOIN commodities c ON c.id = b.commodity_id JOIN locations l ON l.id = b.location_id WHERE l.name = 'Jakarta' AND c.name = 'telur' AND b.location_id = s.location_id AND b.safety_status = 'pass' AND b.usable_until > now() ORDER BY b.id LIMIT 1) WHERE d.id = '{var:did_b}'

sql_steps.name: B: bukti pengadaan allocation_binding+procurement+batch_ids (persis payload persist_supplier_binding)
sql_steps.sql: INSERT INTO decision_evidence (decision_id, evidence_type, payload, is_consistent) SELECT '{var:did_b}', 'human_inspection', jsonb_build_object('allocation_binding', true, 'procurement', true, 'supplier_id', d.supplier_id::text, 'target_location_id', d.target_location_id::text, 'batch_ids', jsonb_build_array(b.id::text)), true FROM decisions d, LATERAL (SELECT bb.id FROM batches bb JOIN suppliers s ON s.id = bb.supplier_id JOIN commodities c ON c.id = bb.commodity_id JOIN locations l ON l.id = bb.location_id WHERE l.name = 'Jakarta' AND c.name = 'telur' AND bb.location_id = s.location_id AND bb.supplier_id = d.supplier_id AND bb.safety_status = 'pass' AND bb.usable_until > now() ORDER BY bb.id LIMIT 1) b WHERE d.id = '{var:did_b}'

sql_steps.name: B: catat verdict verifier pengadaan (setara fixture tes resmi)
sql_steps.after: B4. POST /actions/verify pengadaan tanpa provider -> UNAVAILABLE, recorded:false
sql_steps.sql: UPDATE decisions SET verified_by = 'gate-verifier-fixture', verifier_note = 'consistent' WHERE id = '{var:did_b}'

sql_steps.name: B/D: batch pemasok terikat dibuat FAIL (menguji gerbang safety read model vs endpoint)
sql_steps.after: B7. GET approval-summary pengadaan sehat -> can_execute TRUE (paritas read model)
sql_steps.sql: UPDATE batches SET safety_status = 'fail' WHERE id = (SELECT (payload->'batch_ids'->>0)::uuid FROM decision_evidence WHERE decision_id = '{var:did_b}' AND payload->>'allocation_binding' = 'true')

sql_steps.name: B/D: batch dipulihkan ke pass sebelum eksekusi
sql_steps.after: B8. GET approval-summary setelah batch pemasok dibuat FAIL -> can_execute FALSE + alasan safety
sql_steps.sql: UPDATE batches SET safety_status = 'pass' WHERE id = (SELECT (payload->'batch_ids'->>0)::uuid FROM decision_evidence WHERE decision_id = '{var:did_b}' AND payload->>'allocation_binding' = 'true')

sql_steps.name: C1: siapkan pengadaan dengan binding batch milik pemasok di LOKASI LAIN (Cianjur)
sql_steps.after: B11. POST /actions/execute pengadaan ulang -> 409 sudah dieksekusi
sql_steps.sql: INSERT INTO decisions (id, decision_type, status, proposed_by, source_location_id, target_location_id, commodity_id, supplier_id, quantity_kg, safe_delivered_cost, expires_at, cost_breakdown, iteration, verified_by, verifier_note) SELECT '11000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000c1', 'supplier_procurement', 'pending_approval', 'supervisor_agent', NULL, jl.id, b.commodity_id, b.supplier_id, 120, 3600000, now() + interval '45 minutes', jsonb_build_object('purchase', '3600000'), 1, 'gate-verifier-fixture', 'consistent' FROM batches b JOIN commodities c ON c.id = b.commodity_id JOIN locations l ON l.id = b.location_id, (SELECT id FROM locations WHERE name = 'Jakarta') jl WHERE l.name = 'Cianjur' AND c.name = 'telur' AND b.safety_status = 'pass' ORDER BY b.id LIMIT 1; INSERT INTO decision_evidence (decision_id, evidence_type, payload, is_consistent) SELECT '11000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000c1', 'human_inspection', jsonb_build_object('allocation_binding', true, 'procurement', true, 'supplier_id', d.supplier_id::text, 'target_location_id', d.target_location_id::text, 'batch_ids', jsonb_build_array(b.id::text)), true FROM decisions d, LATERAL (SELECT bb.id FROM batches bb JOIN commodities c ON c.id = bb.commodity_id JOIN locations l ON l.id = bb.location_id WHERE l.name = 'Cianjur' AND c.name = 'telur' AND bb.safety_status = 'pass' ORDER BY bb.id LIMIT 1) b WHERE d.id = '11000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000c1'; INSERT INTO approvals (decision_id, approved_by, approved, comment) SELECT '11000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000c1', u.id, true, 'gate fixture' FROM users u WHERE u.email IN ('sppg.head@demo.local', 'sppg.nutritionist@demo.local')

sql_steps.name: C2: siapkan pengadaan dengan supplier binding BUKAN pemilik batch
sql_steps.after: B11. POST /actions/execute pengadaan ulang -> 409 sudah dieksekusi
sql_steps.sql: INSERT INTO decisions (id, decision_type, status, proposed_by, source_location_id, target_location_id, commodity_id, supplier_id, quantity_kg, safe_delivered_cost, expires_at, cost_breakdown, iteration, verified_by, verifier_note) SELECT '22000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000c2', 'supplier_procurement', 'pending_approval', 'supervisor_agent', NULL, jl.id, b.commodity_id, (SELECT s2.id FROM suppliers s2 JOIN batches b2 ON b2.supplier_id = s2.id JOIN commodities c2 ON c2.id = b2.commodity_id JOIN locations l2 ON l2.id = b2.location_id WHERE l2.name = 'Cianjur' AND c2.name = 'telur' ORDER BY b2.id LIMIT 1), 120, 3600000, now() + interval '45 minutes', jsonb_build_object('purchase', '3600000'), 1, 'gate-verifier-fixture', 'consistent' FROM batches b JOIN commodities c ON c.id = b.commodity_id JOIN locations l ON l.id = b.location_id, (SELECT id FROM locations WHERE name = 'Jakarta') jl WHERE l.name = 'Jakarta' AND c.name = 'telur' AND b.safety_status = 'pass' AND b.usable_until > now() ORDER BY b.id LIMIT 1; INSERT INTO decision_evidence (decision_id, evidence_type, payload, is_consistent) SELECT '22000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000c2', 'human_inspection', jsonb_build_object('allocation_binding', true, 'procurement', true, 'supplier_id', d.supplier_id::text, 'target_location_id', d.target_location_id::text, 'batch_ids', jsonb_build_array(b.id::text)), true FROM decisions d, LATERAL (SELECT bb.id FROM batches bb JOIN commodities c ON c.id = bb.commodity_id JOIN locations l ON l.id = bb.location_id WHERE l.name = 'Jakarta' AND c.name = 'telur' AND bb.safety_status = 'pass' AND bb.usable_until > now() ORDER BY bb.id LIMIT 1) b WHERE d.id = '22000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000c2'; INSERT INTO approvals (decision_id, approved_by, approved, comment) SELECT '22000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000c2', u.id, true, 'gate fixture' FROM users u WHERE u.email IN ('sppg.head@demo.local', 'sppg.nutritionist@demo.local')

sql_steps.name: C3: siapkan NON-pengadaan (regional_balance) dengan source_location_id NULL + binding batch Jakarta
sql_steps.after: B11. POST /actions/execute pengadaan ulang -> 409 sudah dieksekusi
sql_steps.sql: INSERT INTO decisions (id, decision_type, status, proposed_by, source_location_id, target_location_id, commodity_id, supplier_id, quantity_kg, safe_delivered_cost, expires_at, cost_breakdown, iteration, verified_by, verifier_note) SELECT '33000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000c3', 'regional_balance', 'pending_approval', 'supervisor_agent', NULL, jl.id, b.commodity_id, b.supplier_id, 120, 3600000, now() + interval '45 minutes', jsonb_build_object('purchase', '3600000'), 1, 'gate-verifier-fixture', 'consistent' FROM batches b JOIN commodities c ON c.id = b.commodity_id JOIN locations l ON l.id = b.location_id, (SELECT id FROM locations WHERE name = 'Jakarta') jl WHERE l.name = 'Jakarta' AND c.name = 'telur' AND b.safety_status = 'pass' AND b.usable_until > now() ORDER BY b.id LIMIT 1; INSERT INTO decision_evidence (decision_id, evidence_type, payload, is_consistent) SELECT '33000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000c3', 'human_inspection', jsonb_build_object('allocation_binding', true, 'supplier_id', d.supplier_id::text, 'batch_ids', jsonb_build_array(b.id::text)), true FROM decisions d, LATERAL (SELECT bb.id FROM batches bb JOIN commodities c ON c.id = bb.commodity_id JOIN locations l ON l.id = bb.location_id WHERE l.name = 'Jakarta' AND c.name = 'telur' AND bb.safety_status = 'pass' AND bb.usable_until > now() ORDER BY bb.id LIMIT 1) b WHERE d.id = '33000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000c3'; INSERT INTO approvals (decision_id, approved_by, approved, comment) SELECT '33000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000c3', u.id, true, 'gate fixture' FROM users u WHERE u.email IN ('sppg.head@demo.local', 'sppg.nutritionist@demo.local')

db.run: docker exec mcg-mut-postgres-1 psql -U mealchain -d mealchain -At -F "|" -c "{sql}"

checks.name: A: decisions.status = executed
checks.sql: SELECT status FROM decisions WHERE id = '{var:did}'

checks.name: A: approvals tercatat = 2 (head + nutritionist)
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM approvals WHERE decision_id = '{var:did}'

checks.name: A: PO mock tepat 1 baris, status submitted
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM sap_mock_purchase_orders WHERE decision_id = '{var:did}' AND status = 'submitted'

checks.name: A: nomor PO dari baris DB
checks.sql: SELECT po_number FROM sap_mock_purchase_orders WHERE decision_id = '{var:did}'

checks.name: B: decisions.status = executed (pengadaan)
checks.sql: SELECT status FROM decisions WHERE id = '{var:did_b}'

checks.name: B: source_location_id tetap NULL setelah eksekusi (sisi asal pengadaan)
checks.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN source_location_id IS NULL THEN 'null' ELSE 'terisi' END FROM decisions WHERE id = '{var:did_b}'

checks.name: B: decisions.supplier_id == pemilik batch terikat
checks.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN d.supplier_id = b.supplier_id THEN 'sama' ELSE 'beda' END FROM decisions d JOIN batches b ON b.id = (SELECT (e.payload->'batch_ids'->>0)::uuid FROM decision_evidence e WHERE e.decision_id = d.id AND e.payload->>'allocation_binding' = 'true') WHERE d.id = '{var:did_b}'

checks.name: B: bukti pengadaan tercatat (procurement=true)
checks.sql: SELECT payload->>'procurement' FROM decision_evidence WHERE decision_id = '{var:did_b}' AND payload->>'allocation_binding' = 'true'

checks.name: B: batch uji dipulihkan ke pass setelah pengujian safety
checks.sql: SELECT safety_status FROM batches WHERE id = (SELECT (payload->'batch_ids'->>0)::uuid FROM decision_evidence WHERE decision_id = '{var:did_b}' AND payload->>'allocation_binding' = 'true')

checks.name: B: PO mock pengadaan tepat 1 baris submitted
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM sap_mock_purchase_orders WHERE decision_id = '{var:did_b}' AND status = 'submitted'

checks.name: B: nomor PO pengadaan dari baris DB
checks.sql: SELECT po_number FROM sap_mock_purchase_orders WHERE decision_id = '{var:did_b}'

checks.name: C: 3 keputusan negatif tetap pending_approval & tanpa PO
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM decisions d WHERE d.id IN ('11000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000c1', '22000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000c2', '33000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000c3') AND d.status = 'pending_approval' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sap_mock_purchase_orders p WHERE p.decision_id = d.id)

checks.name: hanya 2 PO lahir dari 5 keputusan gate ini (A+B); ketiga negatif tanpa PO

compare.name: A: nomor PO respons API == baris DB
B: nomor PO pengadaan respons API == baris DB
A: jumlah approval DB == min_approvals yang diwajibkan API
